subject: English
question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: a) To fill the basin of Baikal, it will take about --- for all the rivers of the world. (i) four hundred years ii) one month iii) one year iv) two weeks b) Lake Baikal turns ---- when wind gets stronger. i) black ii) blue iii) green iv) dark blue c) This exceptional lake is a----. i) stormy sea ii) stormy lake iii) pacific lake iv) Siberian lake sea d) The water of the lake looks ----. i) green and blue ii) black iii) green iv) blue e) Lake Baikal is situated in ----. i) Asia ii) America iii) Africa iv) Arabia f) The lake area is ----. i) 31,500 sq. km ii) 31,500 km. iii) 557,000 sq km iv. 23,000 sq km g. The length of the lake is ----. i) 636 km ii) 630 km iii) 650 km iv) 536 km Extra Practices h) The look of Lake Baikal û ---. i) fine ii) wonderful iii) excellent iv) exceptional i) The maximum depth of the lake is ----. i) 1600 km ii) 1620 km iii) 1620m iv) 1550 m j) Baikal is a ——. (i) stormy sea (ii) pacific lake (iii) stormy lake (iv) pacific sea k) The water of the lake looks——. (i) green and blue (ii) green and dark blue (iii) green (iv) blue l) When wind gets stronger. Lake Baikal turns——. (i) green (ii) blue (iii) dark blue (iv) black m) The average depth of the lake is ——. (i) 703 m (ii) 730 m (iii) 70.3 m (iv) 730 cm n) To fill the basin of Baikal, it will take about one year for all the ——. (i) ponds of the world (ii) rivers of Bangladesh (iii) rivers of the world (iv) ponds and rivers of Bangladesh o) — is the deepest and must ancient lakes of the world. (i) Lake Panama (ii) Lake Baikal (iii) Lake Sahara (iv) Lake Shaikh p) It is situated in the center of — (i) Africa (ii) Asia (iii) Europe (iv) Sudan
guide_solution: a. iii) one year; b. i) black; c. ii) stormy lake; d. i) green and blue; e. i) Asia; f. i) 31,500sq. km; g. i) 636 km; h. iv) exceptional; i. iii) 1629 m; j. (iii) ; k. (ii) ; l. (iv) ; m. (ii); n. (iii) ; o. (ii) Lake Baikal; p. (ii) Asia.
